title: Fixed Cubby and Offset Perch Climbing Frame
description: One newly authored complete fixed pet climbing-and-rest frame appearance. A broad chamfered base carries a low hollow cubby with a real circular front passage, full floor and rear/side walls, and a wide flat roof landing. A separate front-right post carries an offset intermediate step; a complete tall rear-right post rises to a thick open upper resting bowl with an actual floor and raised rim. The posts have shallow finite circumferential ridges as a stylised covering, not simulated rope or added independent models. New numeric geometry throughout, not a raised two-bay hutch with its roof removed or a nesting box multiplied. One prop zero scenes, three opaque constant materials. Empty static artistic furniture only: no animal, species/size fit, usable climbing route, stability, carrying/load capacity, scratching performance, animal welfare, manufacture or real-world safety claim. Rigging, animation and interaction are not made.
